metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure release-delivery from .claude/orrery/plan.json, with .claude/orrery/decisions.md applied. # Evidence paths are relative to the repo root. The brief is the repo CLAUDE.md Deployment section (CLAUDE.md:111-129). title: "Release delivery: checks, migration gate, Pages and Vercel" subtitle: Five parallel CI checks gate the production migration; Pages publishes only once the matching backend and its database answer kind: process direction: right layout: { spacing: 0.5, layering: simplex } legend: dashed: Message flow between pools groups: pool-gha: type: pool label: GitHub Actions evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:1-226 lane-ci: type: lane label: ci.yml checks in: pool-gha evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:16-208 lane-deploy: type: lane label: migrate.yml, deploy-frontend.yml in: pool-gha evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:210-226 pool-vercel: type: pool label: Vercel evidence: backend/vercel.json:1-24 pool-neon: type: pool # decisions.md 2: Neon is labelled "Neon PostgreSQL", no region label: Neon PostgreSQL evidence: .github/workflows/migrate.yml:33-43 nodes: push: label: Push or PR bpmn: start in: lane-ci # on: push to main, pull_request, workflow_dispatch evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:2-6 split: bpmn: parallel in: lane-ci evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:16-208 j-fe: label: frontend note: lint, build, test bpmn: service-task in: lane-ci evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:18-25 j-pages: label: frontend-pages-build bpmn: service-task in: lane-ci evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:30-60 j-be: label: backend note: ruff, mypy, pytest, alembic check bpmn: service-task in: lane-ci evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:65-117 j-pg: label: postgres-migrations note: pgvector, pytest, alembic check bpmn: service-task in: lane-ci # the semantic-search revision runs CREATE EXTENSION vector, so the job installs pgvector before it starts the cluster evidence: - .github/workflows/ci.yml:119-202 - .github/workflows/ci.yml:145-157#pgvector j-sec: label: security bpmn: service-task in: lane-ci evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:204-208 join: bpmn: parallel in: lane-ci # migrate needs all five check jobs evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:212#needs is-main: label: Push to main? bpmn: exclusive in: lane-ci evidence: [.github/workflows/ci.yml:211, .github/workflows/ci.yml:220] checks-only: label: Checks only bpmn: end in: lane-ci evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:211 migrate: label: alembic upgrade head note: production environment bpmn: service-task in: lane-deploy evidence: .github/workflows/migrate.yml:17-43 align: split build: # the artifact is uploaded only after the wait (deploy-frontend.yml:92-95) label: Build for GitHub Pages bpmn: service-task in: lane-deploy evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:43-55 wait: label: Backend version and DB ready within 10 min? bpmn: exclusive in: lane-deploy # polls /health and /health/db every 10 s until a 10-minute deadline evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:57-90 deploy: label: Deploy GitHub Pages note: upload artifact, then deploy-pages bpmn: service-task in: lane-deploy evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:92-110 live: label: New frontend live bpmn: end in: lane-deploy evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:101-103 align: deploy kept: label: Old Pages stays live bpmn: end-error in: lane-deploy # throw "The existing Pages deployment remains active." evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:88 vercel-deploy: # the name docs/architecture.md uses label: Vercel Git deployment note: outside Actions bpmn: service-task in: pool-vercel # decisions.md 3: project ledger-sync-api linked to GitHub, productionBranch main evidence: [CLAUDE.md:122, backend/vercel.json:3-16] neon-db: label: Production database # decisions.md 2: PgBouncer pooler note: PgBouncer pooler bpmn: data-store in: pool-neon evidence: [.github/workflows/migrate.yml:36#LEDGER_SYNC_DATABASE_URL, CLAUDE.md:119, backend/src/ledger_sync/db/session.py] align: migrate edges: - { from: push, to: split, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:2-6 } - { from: split, to: j-fe, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:18 } - { from: split, to: j-pages, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:30 } - { from: split, to: j-be, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:65 } - { from: split, to: j-pg, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:119 } - { from: split, to: j-sec, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:204 } - { from: j-fe, to: join, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:212 } - { from: j-pages, to: join, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:212 } - { from: j-be, to: join, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:212 } - { from: j-pg, to: join, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:212 } - { from: j-sec, to: join, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:212 } - { from: join, to: is-main, evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:211 } - { from: is-main, to: checks-only, label: no (PR or branch), evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:211 } - { from: is-main, to: migrate, label: "yes", evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:210-217 } - { from: migrate, to: neon-db, label: upgrade head, flow: message, evidence: .github/workflows/migrate.yml:33-43 } - { from: migrate, to: build, evidence: ".github/workflows/ci.yml:219-222#needs: migrate" } - { from: build, to: wait, evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:57 } - from: wait to: vercel-deploy label: polls /health, /health/db flow: message evidence: [.github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:72-77, backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:378-403] - from: wait to: deploy label: "yes" evidence: [.github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:76-79, .github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:106] - { from: wait, to: kept, label: timeout, evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:88 } # /health/db opens a connection and runs SELECT 1; the wait needs database === 'connected' - from: vercel-deploy to: neon-db label: SELECT 1 (/health/db) flow: message evidence: [backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:384-393, .github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:77] - { from: deploy, to: live, evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:108-110 } # decisions.md 3: Vercel deploys main through its Git integration, outside Actions - { from: push, to: vercel-deploy, label: "Git integration, main only", flow: message, evidence: CLAUDE.md:122 }

text.tspan: RELEASE DELIVERY: CHECKS, MIGRATION GATE, PAGES AND VERCEL
Five parallel CI checks gate the production migration; Pages publishes only once the matching backend and its database answer
